nome_jp: バーチカル・ワイバーン
testo:
Shield Trigger Plus
STP When you put this creature, choose one of your opponent's creatures that has power 12000 or less and destroy it.
■ When you put this creature, until the start of your next turn, whenever you are attacked, your opponent chooses one of their creatures that has the lowest power and destroys it.

Shield Trigger Plus
